items.line: [[Kea]] (also pronounced ''Tzia'') is a very nearby destination, too, less than two hours from the port of Lavrio.

[[Evvia|Evia]], or Euboea, is the second-largest Greek island in area and population, after Crete, and in close proximity to Athens. In less than 1.5 hours by bus, train, or car, you can reach [[Chalcis|Chalkis]], or Halkida, the island's capital city and enjoy the local beaches, Ottoman castle on the hill, the promenade with bars & restaurants. From here you can continue to [[Kymi]] and take the ferry to [[Skyros]] island or choose to explore the islands hidden gems.
[[Sounio]], Ktel bus starts from central Athens and also stop in some areas in south Athens. 1 hour from central Athens by car.
Day trips to the [[Corinth]] Canal, the ancient theatre at [[Epidaurus]] and to the ancient sites of [[Olympia (Greece)|Olympia]], [[Delphi]] and [[Mycenae]] are easy with a rental car.
Towns along the [[Peloponnese]] such as [[Nafplion]] are charming and worthwhile.
